title: Configuration code bound
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, Boolean input word $x$, natural number $S$, and configuration $C$ of $N$ on $x$, the code of $C$ using window size $S$ is less than $2^{K(N)(S+\log_2(|x|)+1)}$, where $K(N)$ is twice the encoded chunk width for $N$ plus two, and $\log_2(n)$ here denotes the specified quantity $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
hypotheses_covered: configuration C of N on x
